families.name: random
families.note: uniform random scores: ROC-AUC 0.5, PR-AUC = prevalence

families.name: logistic
families.note: L2 logistic, standardized, one-hot land cover

selection.rule: simplest family with mean LORO PR-AUC >= best - 0.01 and mean LORO ROC-AUC >= best - 0.01; complexity order slope_only < logistic < logistic_balanced < lgbm_stumps < lgbm_current < lgbm_balanced

unavailable_groups.geology: no geologic map is downloaded for the region
unavailable_groups.soil: SoilGrids rasters in data/raw/soilgrids cover only the Rainier box, so no training row has them
unavailable_groups.precipitation_climatology: no rainfall normals (PRISM or similar) are downloaded; the Open-Meteo archive holds only event and control windows
unavailable_groups.distance_to_roads: data/raw/osm/washington-latest.osm.pbf exists but is not rasterized to the grid and no OSM reader is installed
